profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Google Research | Weather & Geospatial AI

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Research
positions.description:
Brought live Google DeepMind cyclone forecasts to meteorologists and the general public https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/12/science/google-hurricane-ai.html
Built weather maps & personalized AI weather summaries for Pixel Weather app
https://www.androidauthority.com/pixel-weather-app-review-3473172/
Shipped deep learning-based precipitation forecasts to Google Search and Maps, including building out serving support for densely-gridded data
https://research.google/blog/metnet-3-a-state-of-the-art-neural-weather-model-available-in-google-products/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Maps
positions.description:
Tech Lead for Google’s on-map customization server, which produced search result maps, directions, personalization, and crisis maps
Software engineer for on-map busyness https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_xLgXIhebxA&t=317s
Designed platform support for on-map customization, powering Google Maps products and SDK
https://mapsplatform.google.com/resources/blog/introducing-data-driven-styling/

positions.title: Software Engineer, Google Maps
positions.description: Designed and implemented on-map customization features spanning mobile client rendering, web rendering, labeling, styling, and serving https://www.engadget.com/2017-12-06-google-maps-motorcycle-mode-india.html
